intentionalHolds.rationale: Compile against the minimum supported Node LTS declaration surface so accidental Node 24/26-only API usage is caught while CI executes Node 22, 24, and 26.
The checked-in generated calendar components implement the version 9 API. A version 10 migration requires dedicated interaction and visual certification and is outside the CI baseline.
TypeScript 6 is the promoted v3 compiler contract. TypeScript 7 is a separate compiler and declaration-output migration.
